title: 潮流渦輪機海床固定系統
subcategoryTitle: 海洋能與地熱系統技術
subcategoryTitleEn: Ocean energy and geothermal system technology
summary: 潮流渦輪機必須固定在流速每秒三四公尺、每六小時反向一次的海床上，而那裡往往是被水流沖得乾乾淨淨的裸露岩盤。固定的方式有靠重量壓住的重力基座、鑽進岩盤的樁，以及乾脆不固定的浮式平台。蘇格蘭奧克尼的歐洲海洋能源中心是這些方案的主要試驗場。課程定量分析傾覆力矩、重力基座的穩定、鑽孔樁的握裹力、沖刷深度、葉片通過頻率與每天可作業的時數。
summaryEn: A tidal turbine must be fixed to a seabed swept by three or four metres a second reversing every six hours, often bare rock scoured clean. Options are gravity bases held by weight, piles drilled into the rock, and floating platforms not fixed at all. The European Marine Energy Centre in Orkney, Scotland, is the main proving ground for them. The course quantifies overturning moment, stability of a gravity base, grip of a drilled pile, scour depth, blade-passing frequency and workable hours a day.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 把渦輪機固定在急流的海床上：傾覆力矩、重力基座、鑽孔樁、沖刷與作業時窗
v30FocusEn: Fixing a turbine to the seabed in a tidal race: overturning moment, gravity bases, drilled piles, scour and working windows

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：潮流渦輪機海床固定系統
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潮流功率密度」與「推力造成的傾覆力矩」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power of a tidal stream" and "Overturning moment from thrust": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「潮流功率密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power of a tidal stream" is correct?
options: 潮流渦輪機像水下的風機，直接擷取流動海水的動能。
海流速度那麼慢，根本發不出什麼電。
渦輪機在水裡受到的力，只有往下游推的推力。
optionsEn: A tidal-stream turbine is like an underwater wind turbine, taking kinetic energy directly from moving seawater.
Ocean currents are so slow that they can hardly produce any power.
The only load on a turbine in water is thrust pushing it downstream.
quiz.explanation: 潮流渦輪機像水下的風機，直接擷取流動海水的動能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tidal-stream turbine is like an underwater wind turbine, taking kinetic energy directly from moving seawater. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮流功率密度：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Power of a tidal stream: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「潮流功率密度」如何決定「潮流渦輪機海床固定系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power of a tidal stream” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 潮流渦輪機像水下的風機，直接擷取流動海水的動能。海水密度約為空氣的八百多倍，所以即使流速只有每秒 2 至 3 公尺，功率密度也相當於風速數十公尺的強風，同樣功率所需的轉子小得多。功率與流速的三次方成正比，因此場址多選在海峽與岬角等流速被地形加速的地方；大小潮之間流速相差近一倍，出力相差可達數倍。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tidal-stream turbine is like an underwater wind turbine, taking kinetic energy directly from moving seawater. Seawater is more than eight hundred times denser than air, so even at 2–3 m/s the power density equals a gale of tens of metres per second and the rotor for a given power is far smaller. Power is proportional to the cube of flow speed, so sites are straits and headlands where geography accelerates the flow; speed nearly doubles between neap and spring tides and output varies several-fold. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：歐洲海洋能源中心於 2003 年成立
steps.observationEn: Project file: The European Marine Energy Centre was founded in 2003
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海流速度那麼慢，根本發不出什麼電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ocean currents are so slow that they can hardly produce any power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「潮流功率密度」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Power of a tidal stream”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Power is proportional to the cube of flow speed, so sites are straits and headlands where geography accelerates the flow; speed nearly doubles between neap and spring tides and output varies several-fold.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：海流速度那麼慢，根本發不出什麼電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「潮流功率密度」的模型 P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p，給定流速下單一轉子的出力（功率係數取 0.4）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p for "Power of a tidal stream", which value is closest to the output of one rotor at the given flow speed (power coefficient 0.4)?
quiz.explanation: P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p；代入 Dr = 20 m、vs = 3.5 m/s，得 2.76 MW（給定流速下單一轉子的出力（功率係數取 0.4））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p; with Dr = 20 m, vs = 3.5 m/s the result is 2.76 MW (output of one rotor at the given flow speed (power coefficient 0.4)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 潮流功率密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power of a tidal stream: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮流功率密度」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Power of a tidal stream” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p；代入 Dr = 20 m、vs = 3.5 m/s，得 2.76 MW（給定流速下單一轉子的出力（功率係數取 0.4））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 vs 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p; with Dr = 20 m, vs = 3.5 m/s the result is 2.76 MW (output of one rotor at the given flow speed (power coefficient 0.4)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise vs by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：vs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.68 MW（+33.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising vs by 10% changes the result to 3.68 MW (+33.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2.76 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 vs 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2.76 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in vs with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p；代入 Dr = 20 m、vs = 3.5 m/s，得 2.76 MW（給定流速下單一轉子的出力（功率係數取 0.4））。
knowledge.textEn: P = ½·ρ·A·v³·C_p; with Dr = 20 m, vs = 3.5 m/s the result is 2.76 MW (output of one rotor at the given flow speed (power coefficient 0.4)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: vs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 3.68 MW（+33.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising vs by 10% changes the result to 3.68 MW (+33.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮流功率密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power of a tidal stream"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
海床是固定不動的。
以海床式聲學都卜勒流剖儀（ADCP）量測至少一個月的流速剖面與紊流強度，依 IEC TS 62600-200 把同步的電氣出力整理成功率曲線。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The seabed is fixed and never moves.

Measure velocity profile and turbulence for at least a month with a bottom-mounted acoustic Doppler current profiler, and reduce simultaneous electrical output to a power curve under IEC TS 62600-200.
quiz.explanation: 以海床式聲學都卜勒流剖儀（ADCP）量測至少一個月的流速剖面與紊流強度，依 IEC TS 62600-200 把同步的電氣出力整理成功率曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure velocity profile and turbulence for at least a month with a bottom-mounted acoustic Doppler current profiler, and reduce simultaneous electrical output to a power curve under IEC TS 62600-200. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮流功率密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power of a tidal stream: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮流功率密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power of a tidal stream” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以海床式聲學都卜勒流剖儀（ADCP）量測至少一個月的流速剖面與紊流強度，依 IEC TS 62600-200 把同步的電氣出力整理成功率曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure velocity profile and turbulence for at least a month with a bottom-mounted acoustic Doppler current profiler, and reduce simultaneous electrical output to a power curve under IEC TS 62600-200. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：場址量測要涵蓋完整的大小潮週期並記錄紊流與波流交互作用，設計負載不可只用平均流速推算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Site measurement should cover full spring-neap cycles and record turbulence and wave-current interaction, and design loads must not be derived from mean velocity alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：強紊流與流向反轉使葉片與傳動鏈承受劇烈的交變負載；早期多部原型機在數週內就發生葉片斷裂，原因是低估了紊流引起的極端負載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strong turbulence and reversing flow load blades and drivetrain with severe alternating forces; several early prototypes broke blades within weeks because turbulence-driven extreme loads were underestimated. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以海床式聲學都卜勒流剖儀（ADCP）量測至少一個月的流速剖面與紊流強度，依 IEC TS 62600-200 把同步的電氣出力整理成功率曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Measure velocity profile and turbulence for at least a month with a bottom-mounted acoustic Doppler current profiler, and reduce simultaneous electrical output to a power curve under IEC TS 62600-200.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 場址量測要涵蓋完整的大小潮週期並記錄紊流與波流交互作用，設計負載不可只用平均流速推算。
knowledge.textEn: Site measurement should cover full spring-neap cycles and record turbulence and wave-current interaction, and design loads must not be derived from mean velocity alone.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC TS 62600 海洋能—波浪、潮流與其他水流能轉換器系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC TS 62600 series: Marine energy – Wave, tidal and other water current converters. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「潮流功率密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Power of a tidal stream" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 強紊流與流向反轉使葉片與傳動鏈承受劇烈的交變負載；早期多部原型機在數週內就發生葉片斷裂，原因是低估了紊流引起的極端負載。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
渦輪機在水裡受到的力，只有往下游推的推力。
optionsEn: Strong turbulence and reversing flow load blades and drivetrain with severe alternating forces.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The only load on a turbine in water is thrust pushing it downstream.
quiz.explanation: 強紊流與流向反轉使葉片與傳動鏈承受劇烈的交變負載；早期多部原型機在數週內就發生葉片斷裂，原因是低估了紊流引起的極端負載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strong turbulence and reversing flow load blades and drivetrain with severe alternating forces; several early prototypes broke blades within weeks because turbulence-driven extreme loads were underestimated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 潮流功率密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Power of a tidal stream: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮流功率密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Power of a tidal stream” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 強紊流與流向反轉使葉片與傳動鏈承受劇烈的交變負載；早期多部原型機在數週內就發生葉片斷裂，原因是低估了紊流引起的極端負載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「潮流渦輪機海床固定系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Strong turbulence and reversing flow load blades and drivetrain with severe alternating forces; several early prototypes broke blades within weeks because turbulence-driven extreme loads were underestimated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：功率與流速的三次方成正比，因此場址多選在海峽與岬角等流速被地形加速的地方；大小潮之間流速相差近一倍，出力相差可達數倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Power is proportional to the cube of flow speed, so sites are straits and headlands where geography accelerates the flow; speed nearly doubles between neap and spring tides and output varies several-fold.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海流速度那麼慢，根本發不出什麼電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ocean currents are so slow that they can hardly produce any power." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 強紊流與流向反轉使葉片與傳動鏈承受劇烈的交變負載；早期多部原型機在數週內就發生葉片斷裂，原因是低估了紊流引起的極端負載。
knowledge.textEn: Strong turbulence and reversing flow load blades and drivetrain with severe alternating forces; several early prototypes broke blades within weeks because turbulence-driven extreme loads were underestimated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「推力造成的傾覆力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Overturning moment from thrust" is correct?
options: 渦輪機在水裡受到的力，只有往下游推的推力。
基座只要夠重，放在哪裡都可以。
水流對轉子的推力作用在離海床二十公尺高的輪轂上，對基座來說就是一個想把整座結構向下游推倒的力矩——推力乘以輪轂高度。

steps.title: 推力造成的傾覆力矩：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Overturning moment from thrust: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「推力造成的傾覆力矩」如何決定「潮流渦輪機海床固定系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overturning moment from thrust” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 水流對轉子的推力作用在離海床二十公尺高的輪轂上，對基座來說就是一個想把整座結構向下游推倒的力矩——推力乘以輪轂高度。這個力矩每六個小時反向一次，一年七百多次由一邊倒向另一邊；在每一次漲落之間，紊流與波浪又讓它不停地抖動。基座的每一種型式，本質上都是在回答同一個問題：用什麼來抵抗這個力矩——是自己的重量與寬度，是樁與岩石之間的握裹，還是繫纜的拉力。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thrust on the rotor acts at the hub twenty metres above the bed, and to the foundation that is a moment trying to tip the whole structure downstream, thrust times hub height. It reverses every six hours, over seven hundred times a year from one side to the other, and between each turbulence and waves keep it shaking. Every type of foundation is in essence an answer to one question, what resists this moment: its own weight and breadth, the grip of pile on rock, or tension in mooring lines. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「推力造成的傾覆力矩」的模型 M = ½·ρ·A·v²·C_T·h，轉子直徑 20 m、流速 3.5 m/s、推力係數 0.85、輪轂高 20 m 時對海床的傾覆力矩最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model M = ½·ρ·A·v²·C_T·h for "Overturning moment from thrust", which value is closest to the overturning moment at the seabed for a 20 m rotor at 3.5 m/s with a thrust coefficient of 0.85 and a 20 m hub height?
options: 335 MN·m
optionsEn: 335 MN·m
quiz.explanation: M = ½·ρ·A·v²·C_T·h；代入 D = 20 m、v = 3.5 m/s、Ct = 0.85、h = 20 m，得 33.5 MN·m（轉子直徑 20 m、流速 3.5 m/s、推力係數 0.85、輪轂高 20 m 時對海床的傾覆力矩）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: M = ½·ρ·A·v²·C_T·h; with D = 20 m, v = 3.5 m/s, Ct = 0.85, h = 20 m the result is 33.5 MN·m (overturning moment at the seabed for a 20 m rotor at 3.5 m/s with a thrust coefficient of 0.85 and a 20 m hub height). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 推力造成的傾覆力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Overturning moment from thrust: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「推力造成的傾覆力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Overturning moment from thrust” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：M = ½·ρ·A·v²·C_T·h；代入 D = 20 m、v = 3.5 m/s、Ct = 0.85、h = 20 m，得 33.5 MN·m（轉子直徑 20 m、流速 3.5 m/s、推力係數 0.85、輪轂高 20 m 時對海床的傾覆力矩）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 v 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M = ½·ρ·A·v²·C_T·h; with D = 20 m, v = 3.5 m/s, Ct = 0.85, h = 20 m the result is 33.5 MN·m (overturning moment at the seabed for a 20 m rotor at 3.5 m/s with a thrust coefficient of 0.85 and a 20 m hub height). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise v by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 40.6 MN·m（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 40.6 MN·m (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 33.5 MN·m（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 v 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 33.5 MN·m (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in v with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 40.6 MN·m（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「推力造成的傾覆力矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Overturning moment from thrust"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以塔柱底部的應變計量測彎矩的時間歷程，統計它的極值與疲勞載重譜。
水下的結構有水的阻尼，所以不會共振。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Strain gauges at the tower base record bending moment over time, compiled into extremes and a fatigue load spectrum.
Structures under water are damped by it and so cannot resonate.
quiz.explanation: 以塔柱底部的應變計量測彎矩的時間歷程，統計它的極值與疲勞載重譜。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Strain gauges at the tower base record bending moment over time, compiled into extremes and a fatigue load spectrum. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 推力造成的傾覆力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Overturning moment from thrust: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「推力造成的傾覆力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Overturning moment from thrust” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以塔柱底部的應變計量測彎矩的時間歷程，統計它的極值與疲勞載重譜。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Strain gauges at the tower base record bending moment over time, compiled into extremes and a fatigue load spectrum. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：輪轂高度要以流速剖面的發電增益與基座成本一起最佳化，並以雙向的極端與疲勞載重設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Optimise hub height on energy gain from the velocity profile against foundation cost, designing for extreme and fatigue loads in both directions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把輪轂架得更高以取得更快的水流時，力臂變長，傾覆力矩與基座的成本增加得比發電量還快。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Raising the hub for faster flow lengthens the lever arm, and overturning moment and foundation cost grow faster than energy. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「推力造成的傾覆力矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Overturning moment from thrust" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
基座只要夠重，放在哪裡都可以。
把輪轂架得更高以取得更快的水流時，力臂變長，傾覆力矩與基座的成本增加得比發電量還快。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A base that is heavy enough can be set anywhere.
Raising the hub for faster flow lengthens the lever arm, and overturning moment and foundation cost grow faster than energy.
quiz.explanation: 把輪轂架得更高以取得更快的水流時，力臂變長，傾覆力矩與基座的成本增加得比發電量還快。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising the hub for faster flow lengthens the lever arm, and overturning moment and foundation cost grow faster than energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 推力造成的傾覆力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Overturning moment from thrust: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「推力造成的傾覆力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Overturning moment from thrust” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把輪轂架得更高以取得更快的水流時，力臂變長，傾覆力矩與基座的成本增加得比發電量還快。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「潮流渦輪機海床固定系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the hub for faster flow lengthens the lever arm, and overturning moment and foundation cost grow faster than energy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Tidal Turbine Seabed Mounting Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：基座的每一種型式，本質上都是在回答同一個問題：用什麼來抵抗這個力矩——是自己的重量與寬度，是樁與岩石之間的握裹，還是繫纜的拉力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every type of foundation is in essence an answer to one question, what resists this moment: its own weight and breadth, the grip of pile on rock, or tension in mooring lines.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「渦輪機在水裡受到的力，只有往下游推的推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The only load on a turbine in water is thrust pushing it downstream." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把輪轂架得更高以取得更快的水流時，力臂變長，傾覆力矩與基座的成本增加得比發電量還快。
knowledge.textEn: Raising the hub for faster flow lengthens the lever arm, and overturning moment and foundation cost grow faster than energy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
